verify_command: for r in $(jq -r '.expected_links[] | select(.status=="live") | .url + " " + .href + " " + (.expected_count|tostring)' data/inbound_links.json | tr ' ' '|'); do u=${r%%|*}; rest=${r#*|}; h=${rest%%|*}; n=${rest##*|}; b=$(curl -sL -m 30 -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Googlebot/2.1)' "$u"); c=$(printf '%s' "$b" | /usr/bin/grep -ao "href=\"$h\"" | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "$c" = "$n" ] && echo "OK   $u" || echo "FAIL $u expected $n got $c"; done
verify_note: One pass over every expected placement. A FAIL means the link was removed by a later deploy of that site, which has already happened twice. Use /usr/bin/grep, not grep: a shell function on this machine shadows grep and swallows its output.
